Here are essential and commonly used Hebrew words and phrases for beginners, organized by category . You can explore structured vocabulary lists on [Teach Me Hebrew](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html) and beginner guides via [HebrewPod101](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/blog/2021/09/23/hebrew-beginner-words/).[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/step-1-basic-hebrew.html)[[2]](https://preply.com/en/blog/hebrew-words-370-terms/)[[3]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html)[[4]](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/blog/2021/09/23/hebrew-beginner-words/)

### Greetings & Goodbyes

- **Shalom (שלום):** Hello, goodbye, or peace
- **Boker tov (בוקר טוב):** Good morning
- **Erev tov (ערב טוב):** Good evening
- **Laila tov (לילה טוב):** Good night
- **Lehitra'ot (להתראות):** See you later[[1]](https://beelinguapp.com/blog/%22shalom-and-more-essential-hebrew-phrases%22)[[2]](https://preply.com/en/blog/hebrew-words-370-terms/)

### Essential Courtesy

- **Todah (תודה):** Thank you
- **Todah rabah (תודה רבה):** Thank you very much
- **Bevakasha (בבקשה):** Please or you're welcome
- **Slicha (סליחה):** Excuse me or sorry
- **Ken (כן):** Yes
- **Lo (לא):** No[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/4305107/jewish/13-Basic-Hebrew-Words-to-Know-and-Use-All-the-Time.htm)[[2]](https://beelinguapp.com/blog/%22shalom-and-more-essential-hebrew-phrases%22)

### Pronouns & People

- **Ani (אני):** I
- **Atah (אתה):** You (masculine)
- **At (את):** You (feminine)
- **Hu (הוא):** He
- **Hi (היא):** She
- **Anachnu (אנחנו):** We
- **Abba (אבא):** Dad
- **Imma (אמא):** Mom[[1]](https://preply.com/en/blog/hebrew-words-370-terms/)[[2]](https://quizlet.com/154307997/basic-hebrew-words-phrases-flash-cards/)

### Common Questions & Everyday Phrases

- **Ma nishma? (מה נשמע?):** What's up? or How are you?
- **Eifo ha-sherutim? (איפה השירותים?):** Where is the restroom?
- **Kama zeh oleh? (כמה זה עולה?):** How much does this cost?
- **Be-seder (בסדר):** Okay or fine[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)[[2]](https://beelinguapp.com/blog/%22shalom-and-more-essential-hebrew-phrases%22)[[3]](https://preply.com/en/blog/hebrew-words-370-terms/)

If you want to practice more, let me know if you would like **greetings**, **travel terms** , or **numbers** next.
